summary: Verified the search-bar / global-nav overlap fix on the Home page and regression-tested /stays. Tested 4 viewports (mobile 390x844, small 640x900, tablet 768x1024, desktop 1280x800). On every viewport the hero search pill sits below the global Navigation with a positive gap; Stays and Services tab icons + labels are fully visible above the white pill. The /stays sticky search bar is also positioned below the nav with a 12px gap and the Filters button is clickable and opens the Filters modal correctly.

verification_details.home_page_after_scroll: Search bar scrolls with page and passes UNDER the fixed nav (nav z-50 > band z-20). Nav covers the bar, not the reverse - Stays/Services icons remain fully visible. This is expected scroll-with-content behavior, not a regression of the reported bug.
verification_details.stays_filters_button: clickable, opens stays-filters-modal successfully on mobile

critical_code_review_comments: Layout uses hard-coded pixel offsets (pt-[170px]/pt-[200px]/pt-[210px] on Home; top-[123px]/top-[68px] + pt-[200px]/pt-[152px] on Stays). If the Navigation's height ever changes (e.g., logo resize, new tab added) these will silently de-sync and overlap will re-appear. Recommend extracting the nav height into a CSS custom property (e.g., --nav-h) set from JS via a ResizeObserver on the <nav>, then using calc(var(--nav-h) + 12px) for the search-bar offset. This makes the spacing self-correcting.

Home.js line 208 uses negative margin '-mt-[140px]' on HeroSlideshow to pull the slideshow up under the search band. This couples three magic numbers (pt on band, -mt on slideshow, nav height) - same robustness concern as above.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The search-bar overlap bug reported by the user is fixed. Bounding-box assertions (sb.y >= nav.bottom) pass on all 4 viewports for Home and 3 viewports for Stays. Screenshots at /app/.screenshots/home_{mobile,small,tablet,desktop}.png and /app/.screenshots/stays_mobile.png + stays_filters_modal.png visually confirm Stays/Services tabs are fully uncovered. No code changes were made by the testing agent.
rca_of_the_issue: Root cause: Home.js's search-band wrapper previously used pt-32 sm:pt-36 (128px / 144px), but the global Navigation is 157px tall on mobile (logo row + Stays/Services tab strip) and ~190-192px on sm/md+ (taller logo, no tab strip), so the white pill rendered ON TOP of the Stays/Services icons. Fix applied by main agent: bumped padding to pt-[170px] sm:pt-[200px] md:pt-[210px], leaving a 13-18px gap below the nav on every viewport. Verified by bounding-box math and visual screenshots.
